semantic_scope: Controlled positive ground-fact language only, after exact full supplied-document equality with this retrieval arm premise. Any unparsed syntax, conflicting exact scalar source, exception, conditional or omitted context abstains. This is not a general free-form legal parser.

clause_segmentation.gaps: Whitespace only before, between and after all matched clauses; every clause must parse; at least1 and at most16. Internal whitespace is exact grammar syntax. Final period is mandatory.
clause_segmentation.source_offset_scope: Original Unicode character offsets; exact text and SHA256 retained for each parsed clause.

grammar_patterns.confidentiality_end_link: The confidentiality obligations also end on that date\.
grammar_patterns.return_obligation: The (?P<party>Receiving|Disclosing) Party shall return all written Confidential Information within (?P<delay>[1-9][0-9]{0,8}|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten|eleven|twelve) business days after a written request from the (?P<requester>Receiving|Disclosing) Party\.
grammar_patterns.governing_law: Disputes under (?P<subject>this (?:Agreement|Contract)) are governed by the laws of (?P<jurisdiction>[A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]{0,63})\.

normalization.symbolic_identifiers: lowercase and collapse spaces after regex fullmatch only; never change NLI input or source slices
normalization.exact_positive_scalar: integer1..999999999; no negative, zero, fractions, decimals, inequalities or unit conversions
normalization.unit: day/month/year singular or plural normalize by stripping final s only
normalization.jurisdiction: uninterpreted normalized identifier; no named-place branches
normalization.accepted_character_set: ASCII only for all parsed source clauses and claim; any non-ASCII source/claim abstains. No Unicode case aliases.
normalization.date_reference: Only the Effective, Execution or Start Date, with identical subject/event/reference between source and claim. Bare after disclosure has no admitted unique event anchor.

logical_model.source_statements: Positive ground atoms, all conjunctively true. No implicit closed-world negation.
logical_model.exact_termination_values: Positive integers; for the SAME full key, two distinct exact values cannot both hold.
logical_model.source_consistency: If agreement_termination atoms have same subject/event/reference/qualifier but different (unit,value), abstain entirely. No equivalence or conversion guessed.
logical_model.end_link: Only a source clause immediately following an agreement_termination atom; copies its date anchor into confidentiality_end_same_date. Query link without an independent anchor is unsupported and abstains.
logical_model.neutral_witness: Only when claim predicate does not appear in ANY parsed source atom; both claim-true and claim-false extensions then satisfy all source atoms because no declared cross-predicate axioms exist. Different values within an existing predicate do not get a neutral certificate.

coverage.selected_source_spans: Exactly[[0,len(document)]]; literal document/premise equality, no whitespace or other normalization allowed for coverage.

probabilities.raw: Original native E,N,C logits and T1 softmax always computed and retained before proof policy. Canonical order E,C,N via[0,2,1].
probabilities.certificate: Exactly onehot on certified conclusion; no fit or calibration. Finite-clippedNLL and Brier must be reported even if this certainty is wrong.
probabilities.abstention: Copy raw T1 E,C,N distribution and raw argmax without any change.
probabilities.raw_same_model_ablation: Score the preserved raw T1 outputs independently with no extra model calls and no postmeasurement best-arm selection.

engineering_scope: The six epoch32 CC0 cases are EXPOSED_DEV_REGRESSION; retained original IDs, not fresh confirmation or benchmark generalization.
